items.subject: OpenMP scaling and parallel-region overhead
items.objective: In `src/candidate.cpp`, compare the serial baseline with static row-level OpenMP work sharing using both a parallel region per timestep and one persistent region across all six timesteps. Honor the `threads` budget without relying on global OpenMP state; retain a low-overhead serial path where appropriate. Keep SIMD and temporal blocking out of scope. Verify the full output and boundary behavior on smaller checks and n=256; measure under the official one- and four-core settings so parallel-region overhead and scaling are distinguishable.
